settings.backup.intro: one file with everything: users, dashboards, settings, installed modules and their data. keep it somewhere safe, it contains your calendar passwords and api tokens.

settings.backup.note: restoring keeps a copy of the current data next to the data folder ({folder}). scripted:

settings.notify.intro: modules ring the bell in the app. forward them to your phone with one of these:
settings.notify.ntfyHint: · free, install the ntfy app and subscribe to the same topic
settings.notify.telegramHint: · create a bot with @BotFather, send it a message, get your chat id from @userinfobot
settings.notify.webpush: web push (browser notifications) is not wired yet; ntfy on the phone is the closest thing and takes two minutes.
